articles.title: Stream On This Week: A Demented Joker Homage, a Great Sundance Indie, and a Loving Mel Brooks Tribute
articles.summary: The weekly 'Stream On' newsletter from Consequence helps subscribers answer the common dilemma of what films and TV shows to watch. It provides curated recommendations, guiding individuals through the vast entertainment landscape. This initiative aims to simplify content discovery and optimize leisure viewing choices for a broad audience.

articles.title: Russia shows no sign of compromise as delegations meet in Abu Dhabi
articles.summary: At the World Economic Forum in Davos, U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff discussed the Washington-moderated negotiations between Russia and Ukraine. He detailed the diplomatic efforts to resolve the conflict, highlighting the complexities. This underscores the vital role of international mediation and global forums in tackling major geopolitical challenges, crucial for strategic understanding.

articles.title: Nokia plans GCC, research centres in Karnataka, says industries minister M B Patil
articles.summary: Nokia Corporation plans a significant expansion in Karnataka, India, establishing a new global capability centre (GCC) and research facilities. Karnataka Industries Minister M B Patil confirmed this development, highlighting Nokia's commitment to strengthening its operational and R&D footprint in the state. This move is expected to boost local employment and technological innovation, contributing to India's growing tech ecosystem.

articles.title: Army pays tributes to 10 soldiers martyred in road accident in Jammu
articles.summary: A solemn wreath-laying ceremony was conducted in Jammu, honouring 10 soldiers tragically killed in a road accident in Doda district. The personnel lost their lives along the Bhaderwah-Chamba interstate road. This tribute highlights the immense sacrifices made by armed forces personnel in the line of duty, a crucial aspect for aspiring officers to understand.

articles.title: DC Comics Full April 2026 Solicits And Solicitations
articles.summary: DC Comics has officially released its full April 2026 solicitations, providing an extensive preview of upcoming comic book titles. The announcement details new issues and collections featuring renowned characters such as Batman, Superman, and Wonder Woman, alongside various 'Absolute' editions. This early insight into DC's publishing schedule offers fans and enthusiasts a comprehensive look at future storylines and major releases.

articles.title: Full dress rehearsal of 77th R-Day parade held amid rain, flypast curtailed
articles.summary: A full dress rehearsal for the 77th Republic Day Parade was conducted on Kartavya Path in New Delhi, involving military personnel and artistes who marched amidst morning rains. This crucial dry run ensures the impeccable execution of the upcoming national celebration, showcasing India's diverse cultural heritage and military strength to the world.

articles.title: Spacetech startups to attract $3.5 billion VC, PE money by 2030, says study
articles.summary: India's burgeoning spacetech sector, with over 300 startups, is set for robust growth. A report by Arkam Ventures forecasts private capital inflows into the sector will double by 2030. This highlights India's increasing innovation and self-reliance in space technology, opening new avenues for economic development and strengthening national capabilities, crucial for future strategic advancements.
